purpose: Symptom-first diagnostic catalogue, served by `shesha explain --symptom`. Data, not a document, so it is queried rather than read. Ported from the previous stack's debug.md (29 rows) plus the residue of three rules whose triage moved them here.

symptoms.symptom: Field renders but will not accept input; a button click does nothing
causes: editMode missing or "inherited" on a form whose effective mode resolved to read-only — typically dataLoaderType "none" or an anonymous page.
symptoms.fix: Set editMode "editable" on every interactive component. Walk the tree and assert; do not spot-fix one field.

symptoms.symptom: Button click fires nothing — no console output, no network call
causes: actionConfiguration missing or malformed, or actionName unrecognised.
actionOwner case mismatch — it is "shesha.common", not "Shesha.Common".
The handler script throws before reaching the API call; look for an unhandled exception.
symptoms.fix: Verify actionConfiguration._type is "action-config", actionOwner case matches exactly, and actionName is a documented value. Wrap the script body in try/catch.

symptoms.symptom: A value shows in the field but never persists on save
causes: propertyName typo, or it points at a property the entity does not have.
formSettings.dataSubmitterType is "none".
symptoms.fix: Validate every propertyName against live entity metadata (check --file does this when probe ran against a backend). Confirm dataSubmitterType is set when the form is meant to save.

symptoms.symptom: Anonymous page returns 401 or redirects to login
causes: formSettings.access is not 5 (still the default 3). Create sometimes ignores access on the initial create.
symptoms.fix: Push with access 5 and permissions []. Then re-fetch via ConfigurationItem/GetCurrent and assert access === 5 — the 200 alone proves nothing.

symptoms.symptom: Datalist or datatable shows nothing although the data exists
causes: entityType/sourceType are set on the table component itself instead of on a datatableContext wrapper.
symptoms.fix: Wrap the table in datatableContext; move entityType, sourceType and permanentFilter to the wrapper and clear them from the inner component.

symptoms.symptom: Refresh button, Export to Excel or quick-search do nothing
causes: Toolbar actions target the data wrapper by actionOwner. No wrapper means nothing to target.
symptoms.fix: Add the datatableContext wrapper and set each toolbar action's actionOwner to the wrapper component's id.

symptoms.symptom: A datalist row template renders empty
causes: Missing datatableContext wrapper (see S-05).
The wrapper exists but formId.module / formId.name point at a form that does not exist.
symptoms.fix: Confirm the wrapper exists, then verify the row-template form resolves via ConfigurationItem/GetCurrent.

symptoms.symptom: Dropdown is empty, or shows ids instead of labels
causes: dataSourceType "referenceList" with the wrong referenceListId module/name pair — the canonical silent killer, because a derived name renders empty with no error.
dataSourceType "values" with malformed items; dropdown/radio need {id, label, value}.
symptoms.fix: Copy referenceListId verbatim from the property metadata's referenceListName/referenceListModule. Never derive it from the property name. For manual values, assert all three keys per item.

symptoms.symptom: Card children render in the wrong place or vanish entirely
causes: Children were pushed onto card.components instead of card.content.components.
symptoms.fix: Move children into card.content.components; header content goes in card.header.components. Container slots are per-type — read customContainerNames from ground truth rather than assuming a generic children array.

symptoms.symptom: A conditional tab or container will not hide
causes: hidden returns a string rather than a boolean — commonly _code returning "true" as a string.
The form uses legacy customVisibility, which 0.45 ignores entirely.
symptoms.fix: Use code-mode hidden whose _code returns a real boolean (true hides). Use optional chaining: a create form has no data context initially and a throw fails open, which masks the bug.

symptoms.symptom: A script runs but no error ever surfaces — silent failure
causes: An API call with no try/catch; the promise rejects and nothing is visible.
A .then() chain swallowed the error.
symptoms.fix: Wrap in try/catch with message.error in the catch. Convert .then() chains to await.

symptoms.symptom: Push succeeded with 200 but the UI still shows the old form
causes: The adminportal's IndexedDB stores `form` and `form_lookup` keep serving the previous markup after any push.
symptoms.fix: Clear both IndexedDB stores from a NON-app page (an in-app deleteDatabase blocks silently), then reload. Otherwise you are measuring a ghost of the previous build. `render` does this as part of its own boot.

symptoms.symptom: Push 500: "Unable to translate bytes [E2] at index N from specified code page to Unicode"
causes: The request body was encoded as Windows-1252 — em dashes, curly quotes or accented characters failed to encode. This came from PowerShell's Invoke-RestMethod -Body with a string.
symptoms.fix: Send UTF-8 bytes. This toolchain cannot reproduce it: every write goes through lib/api.mjs, which is UTF-8 and BOM-free by construction. If you see it, something outside the toolchain is doing the push.

symptoms.symptom: Push 500 with an NHibernate or mapping error
causes: formSettings.modelType references an entity that does not exist or is not mapped.
A propertyName references a property the entity does not have.
symptoms.fix: Re-resolve modelType from live EntityConfig and re-check every binding against Metadata/GetProperties.

symptoms.symptom: Form loads on first visit but fails after a hard refresh
causes: A contexts.appContext value is being read as if it survived a refresh, but appContext is in-memory only.
symptoms.fix: Pass the value via the URL and re-read from formArguments, or persist it server-side. localStorage only for non-sensitive state, namespaced.

symptoms.symptom: application.user is undefined inside a script on an anonymous page
causes: The form is anonymous (access 5), so there is no logged-in user.
symptoms.fix: Optional-chain everything (application.user?.x). For anonymous flows take the value from formArguments (URL params).

symptoms.symptom: Submit button no-ops on a form that has onSubmit configured
causes: A toolbar button with actionName "Submit" triggers the form-level submit pipeline, not formSettings.onSubmit directly.
symptoms.fix: Decide which you want: "Submit" runs the form's submit pipeline; "Execute Script" runs an arbitrary script. They are not interchangeable.

symptoms.symptom: Tab key skips a field, or focus order is wrong
causes: Visual order no longer matches the components array order — usually a parent container using flexDirection row-reverse or similar.
symptoms.fix: Match array order to visual order. If the visual reversal is intentional, set tabIndex explicitly.

symptoms.symptom: "has configuration issue(s) — e.match is not a function"; the component or the whole form fails to render
causes: defaultValue is a literal array, number or object. The resolver calls .match() on it, expecting a template string.
Also fires when a versionless component replays its migration chain.
symptoms.fix: Make defaultValue a mustache-template string, or bind through form data instead. Stamp the correct integer version on every component.

symptoms.symptom: "'datatable' has configuration issue(s) — Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'version')"; the table renders empty
causes: An inline column's editComponent/createComponent is a flat component model with no settings wrapper, so the cell reads .settings as undefined and the migration does undefined.version.
symptoms.fix: Wrap it: editComponent = { type, settings: { ...full model including version } }.

symptoms.symptom: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'migrator')" from a datatable cell; the table is blank
causes: A column's editComponent/createComponent is { type: "[default]" }. Only displayComponent resolves [default]; edit/create pass it to the registry and get undefined.
symptoms.fix: Use { type: "[not-editable]" } for read-only, or a concrete { type, settings } editor. Never [default] on edit/create.

symptoms.symptom: An inline table renders rows but no per-row Edit/Delete buttons
causes: No crud-operations column, and/or canEditInline / canDeleteInline are not "yes".
symptoms.fix: Add { columnType: "crud-operations", sortOrder: -1, itemType: "item" } and set the inline flags.

symptoms.symptom: An inline reflist dropdown shows "unknown" for the existing value in edit mode, though options load and saving works
causes: A known cosmetic limitation of reflist dropdowns used as inline-grid editors in @shesha-io/reactjs 0.45.x — the editor cannot pre-resolve the current item to its label.
symptoms.fix: Not a configuration bug. The control is functional. valueFormat / useRawValues toggles do not change it. Leave it alone.

symptoms.symptom: A just-created entity still 404s on Metadata/GetProperties or its Crud/GetAll
causes: A code-first domain change is not live until the backend is rebuilt and restarted.
A NEW entity's dynamic CRUD controller registers only on the boot AFTER its EntityConfig is seeded — the two-boot lag.
symptoms.fix: Rebuild and restart. For a new entity restart twice, then poll its Crud/GetAll for a 200 before authoring any form against it.

symptoms.symptom: HTTP Error 500.0 — ANCM In-Process handler load failure after restarting the backend
causes: IIS Express was relaunched outside Visual Studio, but hostingModel InProcess needs VS's %LAUNCHER_PATH%.
symptoms.fix: Do not relaunch IIS Express directly. Headless: run the Web.Host dll with ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development. Attended: restart from Visual Studio.

symptoms.symptom: A form that rendered before now 404s by name, but fetching it by id still returns markup
causes: A backend restart re-ran the configuration bootstrappers and orphaned the form's live revision; lookups by name filter on isLast.
symptoms.fix: Re-push the markup to restore the live revision. Author forms after restarts, not before, to avoid this within a run.

symptoms.symptom: Datatable shows headers and a correct row count in the pager, but every cell is blank
causes: Column propertyNames are PascalCase, copied verbatim from Metadata/GetProperties paths. Shesha camelCases the QUERY, so the fetch and the count are right, but the cell accessor reads the literal propertyName against camelCase row keys and gets undefined.
symptoms.fix: camelCase every column propertyName, and every input propertyName too. This is the single most misleading failure in the catalogue, because the correct count makes it look like a styling problem.

symptoms.symptom: Datalist card: text overlaps, a quote clips at the card top, fields collapse, or an inner scrollbar appears
causes: The datalist renders each row's card form in a cell that collapses ant-form-item heights and forces white-space nowrap; content-mode text and shared-row chips collapse.
symptoms.fix: Build the row card with name-mode bound text, dimensions fit-content, single-line ellipsis for long text, the status chip on its own row, and card height auto.

symptoms.symptom: Create/edit fields render as read-only spans rather than inputs (and it is NOT an editMode problem)
causes: Components are missing an integer version, so the renderer takes a legacy read-only fallback path. Usually from modelling a form on a versionless legacy seed.
symptoms.fix: Stamp the current version on every component, derived from that type's own migrator chain (probe emits the map). Never seed from a versionless legacy form.

symptoms.symptom: A container's header is squeezed to nothing, or a child overflows its container
causes: A container renders TWO divs. The outer (sha-components-container, the flex item) takes only dimensions and shadow; layout props land on the inner, whose overflow is hard-coded to auto. So the model's own overflow prop is a no-op.
symptoms.fix: Set dimensions.minHeight to "fit-content" on the container. Do not try to fix it with an overflow prop — that channel is dead.
symptoms.note: Residue of former rule R-032, deleted as a rule because it describes runtime physics with no authored value that is right or wrong.

symptoms.symptom: A displayed value shows & or < instead of the character
causes: Mustache {{ }} HTML-escapes & < > and quotes.
symptoms.fix: Use {{{triple braces}}} for trusted display values. GUIDs and numbers are unaffected, so this only shows up on free text.
symptoms.note: Residue of former rule R-035, deleted as a rule because a double brace is correct far more often than not.

symptoms.symptom: Crud/Create 500s on a create dialog whose required foreign key was supposed to be preset by the calling screen
causes: formArguments and setFieldsValue never reach the submit payload. A contextually-preset FK needs BOTH a real bound component AND an onPrepareSubmitData reducer.
symptoms.fix: Bind the FK to a real (possibly hidden) component and reduce it to {id} in formSettings.onPrepareSubmitData.
symptoms.note: Residue of former rule R-045, deleted as a rule because WHICH FKs are preset is a property of the calling screen, not of this form, so it is not checkable from this markup.
